sample_essay:
Recently, our school carried out a project of collecting used books on campus. The aim of this project was to promote resource recycling and provide useful learning materials for students in need.

To begin with, the project was organized by the Student Union. They actively promoted the event through posters and school announcements. The participants mainly consisted of students from various majors and grades. Many students showed great enthusiasm and actively donated their used books. 

In addition, during the project, there were several well-organized activities. Collection points were set up in different locations on campus, such as the library and dormitory areas. Volunteers were arranged to guide the donors and record the information of the donated books. 

In conclusion, this project was a great success. It not only achieved the goal of recycling used books but also enhanced students' awareness of environmental protection and sharing. It is hoped that more such meaningful projects will be carried out in the future.
